meta.name: systematic-debugging
meta.description: Use when encountering any bug, test failure, or unexpected behavior, before proposing fixes

copy.tagline: 系统化排查并修复代码缺陷
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要定位和修复代码中的问题
copy.tagline_en: Systematically diagnose and fix code defects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to locate and fix issues in code

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会按四阶段流程处理技术问题：先调查根本原因（重现、查变更、追踪数据流），再分析模式、提出假设并测试，最后实施单一修复；若连续3次修复失败则建议重新思考架构。
howto.when: 当你报告任何技术问题（如测试失败、运行异常等）且尚未给出修复方案时，Claude 会自动启动此流程，要求先完成根因调查。

say.text: 我的测试突然失败了，帮我找到根本原因。
say.note: 触发 Phase 1 根因调查。

say.text: 这个bug我试了两次修复都没成功，下一步怎么做？
say.note: 触发 Phase 4.5 架构质疑讨论。

say.text: 先别给方案，帮我一步步诊断问题。
say.note: 强制启动完整调试流程。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude follows a four-phase debugging process: first investigate root cause (reproduce, check changes, trace data flow), then analyze patterns, form and test hypotheses, and finally implement a single fix; if 3+ fixes fail, it suggests questioning the architecture.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you report any technical issue (e.g., test failures, unexpected behavior) before proposing a fix; Claude will insist on completing root cause investigation first.

say_en.text: My test just failed, help me find the root cause.
I tried fixing this bug twice but it didn't work, what now?
Don't suggest fixes yet, walk me through diagnosis step by step.
